title: Synthesis of Fluorenebisphenoxy Derivatives by Acid-sulfur Compound Catalyzed Condensation Reaction
abstract: Abstract                An efficient method for the synthesis of fluorenebisphenoxy derivatives from fluorenone and phenoxy compounds is successfully performed by the combined use of concentrated sulfuric acid as catalyst and 3-mercaptopropionic acid as co-catalyst. Several fluorenebisphenoxy derivatives are obtained in good yields by this one-step reaction.
